title: SIGN: Safety-aware Image-Goal Navigation for Autonomous Drones via Reinforcement Learning
core_idea: Propose a sim-to-real reinforcement learning framework that enables image-goal navigation for drones by using continuous end-to-end velocity control, training the visual backbone with auxiliary tasks (image perturbation and future transition prediction) to improve representation, and integrating a depth-based safety module for real-time obstacle avoidance so the drone can explore and reach visually specified targets without external localization or global mapping.
tldr: A sim-to-real RL approach for drone image-goal navigation combining continuous velocity control, auxiliary-augmented visual training, and depth-based safety for real-time obstacle avoidance and target-reaching.
